_comment: QUERYSTRING-PRIVACY-1 shrink-only baseline for scripts/check-query-string-privacy.mjs. An entry permits at most `count` occurrences of `token` in `file`; anything else is a hard failure, and a count that has fallen is reported as prunable debt. This list holds ONLY one-time legacy `?` -> `#` converters. It is not a place to park new work: a new entry means a page is sending user state to the host on every open.

allowed.reason: Legacy converter. Share links used to carry the merchant config in `?s=<base64 JSON>`. The page now emits `#s=`, and this single read converts an old `?s=` link to `#s=` and strips the query with history.replaceState so the value stops reaching the host. Removable once no `?s=` link is plausibly still in circulation.

Legacy converter. Share links used to carry the template id and three overlay toggles in `?t=&f=&ti=&r=`. The page now emits those in the fragment, and this single read moves an old query link into the fragment and strips the query. Removable once no `?t=` link is plausibly still in circulation.
